title.en: Moving-feature cone characterization, path sandwich, and delay headroom

statement.en: MovingFeatureCone characterizes 2D top-eigenvector cones via top_cone_iff, proves deterministic path-wise event inclusions fp_sandwich and intra_boundary_or_osc, and connects AlignmentReals delay headroom and hysteresis to a Schur/BBP endpoint derivation and 0.414607s LDL check.

laws.en: Any unit top eigenpair (x, y) with a + d < 2*mu satisfies 3*x^2 <= y^2 iff (2 / sqrt 3) * |c| <= d - a (top_cone_iff) without dividing by c, x, or y, and for 1 <= B endpoint EP g B implies FP g B (ep_implies_fp).

For g t = drift t + z t under monotone nondecreasing drift, FP g B satisfies the deterministic inclusion EP g B or Early g l or Intra g z l B (fp_sandwich), and an endpoint miss with Intra g z l B implies boundary strip -eta <= g B or window oscillation >= eta (intra_boundary_or_osc).

For supplied lag L + tau (not identified as a first hit), feature_delay_headroom gives sufficient initial stock via inertia_lag_headroom_penalty, feature_delay_extra_headroom equates the diff to tau * (H_1 - Y), and feature_delay_linear_fa_collapse yields warnStock < x_crit at M_delay := tau under linear_fa_leakage_hysteresis margin premises and strict hshort.

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 Mathlib periphery module MovingFeatureCone importing AlignmentReals under [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext] with an environment-wide audit across all 12 module constants.

feature_delay_linear_fa_collapse retains all fixed-feature phi_safe, phi_warn, score-margin, bounded-update, and strict stock-shortfall (hshort) premises of AlignmentReals.linear_fa_leakage_hysteresis; the moving-feature Schur/BBP experiment tests single-endpoint covariance angles at b = 0 rather than supplying those fixed-feature premises.

does_not_show.en: Fixed-d bounds (fp_sandwich, intra_boundary_or_osc) give deterministic event inclusions only, not a probabilistic maximal inequality or high-d rolling limit outside Schur/BBP endpoints.
At 32 trials/cell, mean mass falls across gamma while Wilson 95% CIs cover cone-hit rates (widths 0.2885-0.3268; n=64, gamma=1 [0.3645, 0.6913] misses 0.3598), unable to resolve 0.0038 (1/16 vs 1/4).
Applying feature_delay_headroom requires identifying stock recursion, supplied delay, and initial-stock threshold; feature_delay_linear_fa_collapse further requires strict shortfall hshort (Rule 2).
